action.expression: ((a[1] if g == 'T' or g == 'S' else -a[0] if g == 'T*T' or g == 'S*T' else -a[1] if g == 'T*T*T' or g == 'T*T*S' else a[0]) % 4, (a[0] if g == 'S' or g == 'T*T*T' else -a[0] if g == 'T' or g == 'T*T*S' else -a[1] if g == 'T*T' or g == 'T*S' else a[1]) % 4)

U_symbols.expression: exp(2 * pi * 1j * a[1] * b[0] / 4) if g == 'T' or g == 'S' or g == 'T*T*T' or g == 'T*T*S' else 1

eta_symbols.expression: exp(2 * pi * 1j * a[0] * a[1] / 4) if (g == 'T' or g == 'S' or g == 'T*T*T' or g == 'T*T*S') and (h == 'T' or h == 'S' or h == 'T*T*T' or h == 'T*T*S') else 1
